_comment: Single source of truth for awesome-ai-employee-stack. Verified live on 2026-10-09 via GitHub API through HK proxy. Every entry represents an active building block for autonomous digital workforces.

layers.description: Full-stack frameworks and workspace clients for managing persistent AI team members with specialized roles.

items.name: Bops
items.what: A Mac app where AI bots run business ops. Each bot gets a dedicated Orgo cloud computer (4 screens), AgentMail inbox, and AgentPhone number with human-in-the-loop approval.
items.key_capabilities: Multi-screen cloud desktop, voice/SMS/Email task triggers, Composio app integrations, human-in-the-loop approval gates
items.limitations: Fair Source license; requires Orgo cloud or self-hosted desktop runtime.

items.name: OpenCompany
items.what: Self-improving AI employees that execute multi-step business goals, turn LLM tokens into structured outputs, and track ROI.
items.key_capabilities: Self-evaluating task loops, structured output generation, token ROI tracking
items.limitations: Requires manual LLM provider key configuration.

items.name: CrewMeld
items.what: Enterprise digital workforce platform to manage AI employees like real team members with visual SOP orchestration.
items.key_capabilities: Visual SOP flowchart builder, team member role assignment, enterprise access control

items.name: Zero Employee Company
items.what: Blueprint and code patterns for running a zero-headcount company driven entirely by Paperclip agent harnesses.
items.key_capabilities: Headcount zero architecture, automated budget allocation, agent governance patterns
items.limitations: Architectural guide and blueprint rather than a turn-key binary.

layers.description: Secure environments giving AI agents mouse, keyboard, and display access to drive desktop software.

items.name: Agent Desktop
items.what: Gives any AI agent reliable computer use by inspecting real UI tree structures instead of raw screenshot guessing.
items.key_capabilities: Accessibility tree navigation, native Rust performance, low latency desktop automation

items.name: Hermes Desktop OS1
items.what: Native macOS workspace for Hermes Agent on Orgo cloud computers and remote SSH hosts.
items.key_capabilities: Orgo cloud instance lifecycle, multi-screen remote viewing, SSH host binding
items.limitations: Targeted specifically at macOS client systems.

items.name: Computer Agent
items.what: Desktop app to control your computer with AI via terminal, browser, mouse, and keyboard.
items.key_capabilities: Cross-platform desktop control, local model support, interactive execution overlay
items.limitations: Runs with local user account privileges.

items.name: Korgo Bot
items.what: Persistent AI bots with built-in Orgo cloud computer use for background long-horizon tasks.
items.key_capabilities: Headless cloud desktop execution, persistent background polling
items.limitations: Requires an active Orgo API account.

layers.description: Gateways giving AI bots dedicated email inboxes, phone numbers, and app connections.

items.name: Composio
items.what: Powers 1000+ toolkits, auth management, and sandboxed workbenches for GitHub, Gmail, Slack, HubSpot, and Notion.
items.key_capabilities: OAuth token management, fine-grained tool permissions, multi-account support per bot
items.limitations: Requires Composio API key or self-hosted proxy.

items.name: AgentPhone MCP
items.what: MCP server giving Claude Code and AI agents dedicated phone numbers for SMS, voice calls, and real-time SIP interaction.
items.key_capabilities: Real-time voice streaming, SMS notification webhooks, call transcript generation
items.limitations: Requires Twilio or SIP provider routing.

items.name: AgentMail Toolkit
items.what: Gives each AI bot an isolated email inbox to send, receive, and process inbound email tasks asynchronously.
items.key_capabilities: Inbound email webhooks, thread-aware context parsing, outbound approval hooks
items.limitations: Requires domain DNS MX record configuration for custom domains.
